notes.title: Version 2.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Shutterbugs! 

Thanks to your reports on the community Discord, I was able to fix some important issues:

- Playing with controller will no longer restart the island you are on everytime you interact with menus
- Photos will appear in the gallery again on OSX (you have lost no photos, check the "Open Photos Folder" in the gallery!)
- You'll find a handy link pointing you to the Steam community forums to easily see photos others have shared!

Thank you so much for playing the game, and for reaching out about issues!
